newsitem.title: USA: MCN Energy sees record 97 results.
newsitem.headline: MCN Energy sees record 97 results.

text.p: MCN Energy Group Inc, which Monday reported second quarter operating earnings or $9.1 million up from $5.2 million, said it expects to post record results for all of 1997.
MCN Chairman and Chief Executive Alfred Glancy said the diversified energy holding company continues to benefit from its portfolio-management investment strategy.
"On every operating level, our Diversified Energy group has lifted its contributions to earnings while the Gas Distribution group has continued its solid financial performance," he said.
"Based on what we have accomplished during the first six months and our plans for the second half, we expect 1997 to be another year of record financial results," he said.

Operating earnings per share for the second period were $0.13, up from $0.08 a year ago. The Diversified Energy group posted earnings of $7.9 million, versus $4.4 million. The Gas Distribution unit had earnings of $1.2 million, up from $791,000 a year ago.
For the first six months of 1997, MCN earnings from continuing operations were $90.8 million, or $1.34 per share, compared with $84.2 million, or $1.26 per share.
